operations.text: 0.3.8 splits the loop's doctrine by stage. Every rule stands in exactly one stage file, rendered into your project as a managed artifact: .claude/aiwf-native/ORCHESTRATOR.md (the core, read by every entry door) and .claude/aiwf-native/doctrine/work.md, ticket.md, plan.md and review.md - created on your installation by the first four operations. Each entry door now reads its stage IN FULL from these rendered files instead of the payload documents: /pnp:work reads the core, work.md and your overrides document, and ticket.md when a task routes R2/R3; /pnp:mission reads ticket.md before a dispatch; /pnp:plan reads plan.md; /pnp:review, /pnp:qa and /pnp:qal read the core and ticket.md at their first step, and the auditor is handed review.md. In the payload, docs/WORKFLOW.md is now the map of the stage files, docs/LOOP.md keeps the enforcement hooks, the commit gate, the honest security model and a role-hosts table, and docs/REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md is a pointer stub; a pointer of yours to a section of them now resolves in the stage file the map names. The loop command is removed: its one unique rule (a QA BLOCKED pauses the loop and consumes no correction round) now stands in /pnp:qa. FOUR EMPTY PROJECT ADDITIONS BLOCKS now exist, one at the end of each stage file, carried across every re-render like the block of ORCHESTRATOR.md. A local rule of yours moves into the block of the stage file carrying the rule it modifies, opening with that rule's heading - on your operator's word, never by this update, which moves nothing of yours. This update also re-renders the managed CLAUDE.md region, ORCHESTRATOR.md, the Writer agent, and the Reviewer and QA agents where this installation has them.
